summary: Phase 5 GHR93 infrastructure completed (Tasks 5.0-5.5): untl_witness_bounded resolves Until containment, ghr93_untl_transfer proves U(B,A) formula transfer through tau, ghr93_construct_en provides end-to-end GHR93 e_n construction. Tasks 5.6-5.8 (old code deletion, Round 2 rewrite, final assembly) remain — require rewriting ~600 lines of Round 2 dispatch.

untl_witness_bounded.purpose: Bounded Until witness: given U(B,A)(t) and B-point in (t, bound], produce witness in (t, bound]

ghr93_untl_transfer.purpose: Transfer U(B,A) from d in N to c in M through tau at rank r+delta

ghr93_construct_en.purpose: End-to-end GHR93 e_n: combines untl_transfer + forward game B-point + untl_witness_bounded
ghr93_construct_en.output: e_n with c < e_n ≤ y, mu_holds, B(e_n), A on (c, e_n)

remaining_work_for_phase_5.task_5_6: Delete old forward-game e_n, resp_mod, tau_left/tau_right (~500-700 lines deletion)
remaining_work_for_phase_5.task_5_7: Rewrite Round 2 with GHR93 5-way case split using resp_tau directly (~200-300 lines)
remaining_work_for_phase_5.key_blocker: Biconditional ordering (a_init(k) < p_n iff resp_tau(k) < e_n) requires tau_left or restructured Round 2. The plan's sel_pn_ord trivial chain gives one direction only.

next_action: Continue Phase 5 Tasks 5.6-5.8: rewrite ghr93_case_II body to use ghr93_construct_en instead of forward game, then rewrite Round 2 dispatch
